verdict.rationale: libSQL, the open-source core engine behind Turso, can be run entirely locally/embedded with no server, or as a local libSQL server (turso-docs-2/16/17/30), and is documented as an MIT-licensed open fork of SQLite (turso-gh-1, turso-comm-10). This gives AI-native users a genuine self-hosting path for the database engine itself, but Turso's cloud platform features (managed branching, PITR, embedded-replica sync, Platform API) remain proprietary SaaS with no documented self-hosted equivalent. Missing for 10: a documented self-hosted deployment of the full Turso Cloud service (branching/PITR/replication server), independent confirmation of self-hosted libSQL server production use.
